records.text: keeping an eye on North Works this week :slightly_smiling_face:

records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Nadia,

Appreciate the note. We're a bit slow to get everyone set up but it's on our list this week.

Ben

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Noticed you created a project already, which is great. Anything unclear as you're digging in?

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Works
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin replied [email:8ad5fb0d] saying team setup is "on our list this week", and first project was already reached 7/12, showing real intent. But no invites sent 6 days in (stall_reasons: no_invite) and team rollouts often slip; 8 days left. Roughly even odds unaided.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for the update — makes sense that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time. Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for a larger group.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting your team into your project so the work lands in the right place.

Best,
Nadia
